itens.titulo: Marvell Stock Soars After Raising 2028 Guidance
itens.descricao: Marvell Stock Soars After Raising 2028 Guidance Yahoo Finance
trechos: The biggest surprise was not just the fiscal 2028 increase, but Marvell's forecast for as much as $90 billion in annual revenue by fiscal 2031.
GuruFocus has detected 3 Warning Sign with MRVL.
For fiscal 2028, Marvell now expects revenue of about $20 billion, up from its prior $18 billion outlook and above the $18.2 billion analyst consensus.
The company also said customer revenue in fiscal 2029 could rise 200% or more.

Marvell expects total revenue to reach between $70 billion and $90 billion by fiscal 2031, implying an $80 billion midpoint that is dramatically above the roughly $46.9 billion Wall Street consensus cited by Reuters.
The company has secured a major agreement with Alphabet's Google that could generate as much as $120 billion in revenue through 2033 if performance milestones are met.
Marvell's fiscal 2026 revenue reached $8.2 billion, up 42% year over year, while management has said AI bookings remain exceptionally strong.
Fiscal 2028 therefore becomes a key checkpoint.

itens.titulo: Febraban: bancos preveem corte de 0,25 na Selic em novembro
itens.descricao: Febraban: bancos preveem corte de 0,25 na Selic em novembro CNN Brasil
trechos: Metade dos bancos brasileiros que responderam à Pesquisa de Economia Bancária e Expectativas, da Febraban (Federação Brasileira de Bancos), prevê que a taxa Selic atinja o nível de 13,50% ao final deste ano, com a retomada do ciclo de cortes em março de 2027.
A mediana das projeções indica um novo corte de 0,25 ponto porcentual na taxa Selic na reunião de novembro.
O restante dos respondentes se divide em 30% que não enxerga mais cortes em 2026 e 20% que espera o juro básico em 13,25% ao fim do ano ou menos.
O levantamento da Febraban é realizado a cada 45 dias, após as reuniões do Copom (Comitê de Política Monetária), e nesta edição ouviu 20 instituições entre os dias 22 e 28 de setembro.

Em relação à atividade econômica de 2026, 45% dos participantes avaliam que o PIB (Produto Interno Bruto) deve crescer abaixo do consenso – de alta de 1,85%, conforme a última pesquisa Focus –, diante da desaceleração dos setores mais cíclicos.
Já 40% dos respondentes ainda projetam expansão em linha com a estimativa de 1,85%, com estímulos fiscais e creditícios que tendem a compensar parcialmente os vetores de baixa.

Na comparação com pesquisa realizada em agosto, houve uma piora na percepção dos participantes quanto à dinâmica inflacionária: 50% avaliam que o IPCA deve ficar acima do consenso de 4,9% neste ano, em meio aos choques de oferta simultâneos.
Outros 40% estimam IPCA em torno de 4,9% em 2026.

itens.titulo: Nvidia Strength Is Masking ‘A Whole Lot of Pain’ in the Broader Market, David Rosenberg Says
itens.descricao: Nvidia Strength Is Masking ‘A Whole Lot of Pain’ in the Broader Market, David Rosenberg Says Yahoo Finance
trechos: Nvidia Corp. (NASDAQ:NVDA) is nearing a $6 trillion valuation as major indexes hit records, but Rosenberg Research founder David Rosenberg says that strength is masking "a whole lot of pain" across the broader market.
"Breadth, with a lag, ultimately leads what's going to happen with prices," he said.
Rosenberg said the average S&P 500 stock entered the week about 20% below its 52-week high, while the median stock was down 17%.
"If you're that bullish on AI, just focus on the hyperscalers, focus on the semiconductors," Rosenberg said.

"The rest of the stock market is not really behaving that well." Rosenberg did not name individual companies, but Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet are among the hyperscalers investing heavily in AI infrastructure.
The cap-weighted S&P 500 gained 0.2%, while its equal-weight version fell 4.4%, MarketWatch reported.
Nvidia now carries more index weight than the smallest 256 S&P 500 companies combined.
"Ultimately it's going to be the future revenue flow that's going to determine whether or not the return assumptions make sense right now," he said.

itens.titulo: Sam Altman: Jensen Huang “Selling Picks and Shovels” as NVIDIA Heads for $6 Trillion
itens.descricao: Sam Altman: Jensen Huang “Selling Picks and Shovels” as NVIDIA Heads for $6 Trillion Yahoo Finance
trechos: Key Takeaways - NVIDIA hit a record high this week, putting its market value at about $5.8 trillion and close to $6 trillion.
- In a Vanity Fair interview with Sam Altman, Mark Guiducci cast Jensen Huang as the man "selling picks and shovels during the gold rush," and that role works in shareholders' favor.
- Analysts expect NVIDIA's earnings per share to roughly double this fiscal year, while the stock trades near 20 times forward earnings, about half its five-year average.
NVIDIA (NVDA:NASDAQ) is back at a record high, and it's on the verge of becoming the first company ever worth $6 trillion.
Elon Musk "is like the Mad King Nero character," he said.
"I think Jensen Huang will be the guy who was selling picks and shovels during the gold rush." Then he asked Altman who he wants to be.
Altman declined to play along: "First of all, I never think this way." For NVIDIA shareholders, though, Huang's is the role to want.

He was explaining why investors are piling into Anthropic at prices he says feel overvalued: "Everybody missed out on what is the greatest stock in history, and that is the infrastructure for AI, and that's NVIDIA." The earnings tell the story.

itens.titulo: Metaplanet Sold 10,000 Bitcoin for $790 Million, Then Bought 11,000 Back for $950 Million. What Was the Point?
itens.descricao: Metaplanet Sold 10,000 Bitcoin for $790 Million, Then Bought 11,000 Back for $950 Million. What Was the Point? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Metaplanet Sold 10,000 Bitcoin for $790 Million, Then Bought 11,000 Back for $950 Million.
Quick Read - Metaplanet sold 10,000 Bitcoin for $790 million and repurchased 11,000 for $950 million, ending up with 1,000 extra coins but $160 million less cash.
- The liquidity demo cost shareholders roughly $81 million beyond the extra coins acquired, since Bitcoin's price rose from ~$79,000 to ~$86,400 between the sale and buyback.
(Sponsor) In the third quarter of 2026, Metaplanet made headlines by selling 10,000 Bitcoin (CRYPTO:BTC) for approximately $790 million.
Shortly after, the Tokyo-listed company repurchased 11,000 Bitcoin for around $950 million.
This left Metaplanet with 1,000 more coins but also about $160 million less in cash.

The sale represented about a quarter of the 43,000 Bitcoin the company held in July, raising the question: Did this trading activity demonstrate that a Bitcoin-focused company could sell its assets when necessary?

itens.titulo: Tesla Stocks Gain as 486,532 Deliveries Reset the Bar
itens.descricao: Tesla Stocks Gain as 486,532 Deliveries Reset the Bar Yahoo Finance
trechos: Tesla, the electric-vehicle, energy-storage and autonomy company (NASDAQ:TSLA), rose approximately 0.5% to $380.69 at 10.50am ET on October 6, following its third-quarter delivery report.
The company reported 486,532 deliveries against 464,391 vehicles produced.
That puts deliveries 22,141 vehicles ahead of output, suggesting Tesla worked through existing inventory.
GuruFocus has detected 6 Warning Signs with TSLA.
Energy storage added another substantial number: Tesla deployed 13.7 gigawatt-hours during the quarter.
The valuation picture raises the stakes: shares sit 13.6% above the $335.11 GF Value estimate, leaving less room for disappointing results.
October 21 brings the financial test, when Tesla releases its quarterly results after market close.
